written: 2026-10-20, before any battery-2 image was generated
formats: FORMATS DIFFER, INTENT IS THE SAME: Krea 2 Turbo, MOSS-Image SFT, Qwen-Image-2.1, Qwen-Image-2512 and FLUX 3 Image Klein get the same dense natural-language prompt ('prompt'); FIBO 2.0-dev gets its native structured JSON caption ('fibo_caption') written to say the same thing.
seed_policy: seed 101 for every model first, then 102; seed 102 is dropped first if time runs short

settings.krea-dense: krea2_turbo_fp8 + qwen3vl_4b encoder + qwen_image_vae, 9 steps er_sde/beta cfg 1, no LoRA (same graph as the label run)
settings.moss-prompt: moss_image_sft_int8_convrot, vendor settings 50 steps cfg 3 euler/simple, SLG layer 22, vendor negative, prompt upsampler off (same as the label run)
settings.qwen21: Qwen-Image-2.1 int8, 40 steps euler/simple cfg 1, prompt enhancer off (same as the label run)
settings.fibo: FIBO 2.0-dev bf16 via diffusers, 30 steps guidance 5.0 (the label run's setting after its 130 s rule), the card's t2i negative caption
settings.qwena: Qwen-Image-2512 fp8, 50 steps cfg 4 euler/simple shift 3.1, template negative; only if its speed gate passes (warm <= 120 s per 1024x1792 image)
settings.klein: flux3-image-klein bf16 (distilled), Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct encoder, flux2-vae, 16 steps euler/simple cfg 1, no prompt upsampler (same graph as the label run)

scoring: agent visual reading only (an AI model looking at every image; not a person): realism, anatomy (hands, faces), composition/aesthetic, slop look (1-5 each; 5 = best, slop 5 = no slop), adherence facts for p7. Subjective; a person's blind ranking came after (results/blind_vote.json).
